characters.name: The Pink Panther
characters.description: Private Detective: Has his own private detective agency.

characters.name: FoxMcCloud
characters.description: Badass in Distress: He's a famous space mercenary who's been kidnapped by aNebulous Evil Organisation. Defiant Captive: Despite Static beating him up, Fox absolutelyrefusesto reveal the Landmaster's location to him. Happily Married:Subverted. It's implied that this isnotthe case between him and Krystal. Papa Wolf: He is absolutelyfuriouswhen he asks Static where Marcus is being kept.

characters.name: KrystalMcCloud
characters.description: Happily Married:Subverted. It's implied that this isnotthe case between her and Fox.

characters.name: MarcusMcCloud
characters.description: Distressed Dude: He is a young boy who was kidnapped by The Nine. And to add insult to injury, he's stuck withD.W. Readas a fellow captive.

characters.name: Static
characters.description: Adaptational Villainy: While he was a Cranky villager in theAnimal Crossinggames, he was aJerk with a Heart of Goldlike all villagers of that type. Here, he's aSadistwho is shown to take pleasure in beating up Fox. Sadist: He is shown to take pleasure in beating up Fox.

characters.name: Dora Winifred "D.W." Read
characters.description: Asshole Victim: It's very hard to feel bad about her being kidnapped considering all the crap she has pulled and her generally horrendous and bratty behavior in her home series. Damsel in Distress: A little girl whom The Nine have kidnapped. Not thatshe didn't deserve it, of course. Throw the Book at Them: Does this to Marcus in anger when she believes them being kidnapped was his fault.

characters.name: Dr. Wise/The Brain
characters.description: The Atoner: He used to work for The Nine,and his partner Pinky was killed by them as punishment when he defected. Now, he wants to atone by helping the heroes stop The Nine.

characters.name: The Nine
characters.description: Would Hurt a Child: They kidnapped both MarcusMcCloudand D.W. Read for the sake of furthering their goals.
